name: nydfs-part-500-2026
display_name: NYDFS Part 500 + 504 + 200 + NY SHIELD — Cyber, AML & Virtual Currency
description: Structured knowledge graph for the New York Department of Financial Services Cybersecurity Regulation (23 NYCRR Part 500) following the Second Amendment of 1 November 2023 — with the final controls phase fully effective 1 November 2025 (privileged-access management, endpoint detection + response, automated vulnerability scans for Class A Companies). Plus the AML transaction-monitoring overlay (23 NYCRR Part 504), the virtual-currency BitLicense regime (23 NYCRR Part 200), and the NY SHIELD Act 2019 state-level data-security floor. NYDFS gained de facto US bank-cyber + AML primacy in 2025 as CFPB enforcement was paused.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
regulation_ids: NY SHIELD Act (NY Gen Bus L §899-bb)
